headline: Police officer accused of using Flock cameras to stalk ex-partner, internal investigation launched
summary: An internal affairs investigation has begun, and the police department has temporarily suspended its use of the powerful license plate reader system.
details: New Bedford police officer Emily Pacheco faces an abuse prevention order after her ex-girlfriend accused her of using Flock license plate readers to track her movements. A judge determined Pacheco poses a credible threat and ordered her to surrender all firearms.

The ex-girlfriend alleged that after ending their two-year relationship in April, Pacheco engaged in persistent harassment, including "endless calls," using fake phone numbers, and showing up unannounced at her home. She also claimed Pacheco saw her pull into her home while on duty and refused to let her leave.

An internal affairs investigation is underway regarding Pacheco's alleged misuse of the Flock system. Following inquiries about the allegations, the New Bedford Police Department temporarily suspended its use of Flock cameras pending a review of all past usage.

Flock cameras, or automatic license plate readers, scan and record details of every passing vehicle, including make, model, color, and license plate. This data is then accessible to police officers and other law enforcement agencies, forming a vast data network.

The department's memorandum of understanding explicitly forbids personal use of the license plate reader system or its use for harassment. Any impermissible use can lead to criminal prosecution, civil liability, and immediate termination of department access.

Pacheco was identified as one of the top users of the Flock system this year, according to data obtained by The Light. Her most common reason for searches since April was "traffic infraction," with some searches spanning over a week.

Data also indicates Pacheco accessed multiple Flock networks, sometimes over 100, suggesting she was utilizing data from cameras outside of New Bedford, including neighboring towns like Dartmouth and Fairhaven.
